App details

Inventory / ReadyStock

Keep track of supplies at home, in a workshop or in a small business, offline.

In the worksAndroid

What it’s for

Keep track of food, household supplies and workshop parts, including their quantities, storage places and expiry dates. Use low-stock views and restock lists, and estimate reserve duration from your own consumption rates. Barcode and text recognition on the device help with entry; you confirm suggested details.

Main features

  • Quantities, storage locations and expiry dates.
  • Low-stock alerts and automatic restock lists.
  • Barcode and on-device text recognition help with entry.
  • Estimate how long reserves will last from your rates.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
